contract.name: Reservation Contract Winter 2026/27 (1 Nov 2026 – 30 Apr 2027)
contract.tax_note: All quoted rates include any applicable tax in force at the time of signature of this agreement; an increase of any applicable indirect tax after signing (or a new tax, levy or charge) is added as applicable by law.
contract.child_policy_text: Child between 5 – 11.99 y: 50% on the parental meal rate applicable. Child below 4.99 y: FOC (sharing parents' accommodation). Children above 12 years are considered adults.
contract.cancellation_text: 30 days or more: No cancellation fee. 29 – 21 days prior to arrival: 75% cancellation fee. 20 – 0 days prior to arrival: 100% cancellation fee.
contract.payment_text: With 15 – 21 days prior to arrival 50% advance payment is required to secure the booking. No show charges will be 100% chargeable.
contract.terms_text: Rates are subject to changes with government tax policy. Twin rooms are limited and subject to availability. Please mention the applicable special rate at the time of reservation; special rates are not valid for existing reservations or re-booking. The resort reserves the right to end the special offer within 3 working days. All reservations must be sent to the designated reservation e-mail IDs provided, unless otherwise specified. The agency cannot assign or grant any rights in this contract to third parties without written consent from the hotel. Non-distribution to other non-retail travel agencies (Spain reserved for the hotel / BGH). These rates are not valid until the signature of the contract.
contract.notes: Rates printed BB only, per room. HB / FB = BB + printed meal supplements (dinner USD 30, lunch USD 25 per person). CHECK WITH THE HOTEL: (1) 1 Feb – 30 Apr 2027 has NO Premier (King Parakramabahu Wing) row — the table lists "King Nissankamalla Wing (Family Room)" 420 / 430 instead, so Premier is not priced Feb – Apr. (2) The Family Room (2 interconnecting Superior rooms, 4AD / 2AD+2CH / 3AD+1CH) is printed only as Quadruple BB 420 (Nov – Jan) and 460 (Feb – Apr), plus the single/double 420 / 430 row for Feb – Apr. Triple only in the Premier (King Parakramabahu Wing). The sheet header reads "CUSTOMER NAME: SUMMER 2026" but the duration is 01.11.2026 – 30.04.2027. AI packages (per person over the booked room): BB + Local package USD 25, Premium USD 35; HB + Local USD 30, Premium USD 35. Excursions per person: dolomite figurine workshop 35, batik making 35, paddy harvesting 50, wooden craft 35, wellness 35 group / 50 private, bird watching & boat ride 50 group / 85 private, loris watching 45; monkey watching (incl. park entry) on request. Contacts: general line +94 572 228 655; Property Manager +94 766 474 902; corporate reservations +94 117 765 555 / +94 77 238 7777 / +94 77 328 5555, reservations@ekhohotels.com.
